item.title: Shop-with-a-Cop provides Christmas for over 85 kids
item.description: CARBON COUNTY — For the last nine years, Sgt. Kelly Maynes with the Price City Police Department (PCPD) has organized Carbon County’s Shop-with-a-Cop program. The event grows each year, raising more money and serving more kids. This year, over 85 children were selected to be partnered up with a law enforcement officer to go Christmas shopping at Wal-Mart.
